svg.title: The stack
svg.desc: Exploded view of the stack. Bottom: mini PC hardware with 12 threads, 32 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD and an iGPU. Above it Proxmox VE with local and local-lvm storage. Above that, guests: a Coolify VM with 4 vCPU and 12 GB RAM, a Home Assistant VM, and five LXC containers: adguard, tailscale, frigate, beszel and uptimekuma. On top of Coolify sit the apps Stirling-PDF and n8n with Postgres 16.

g.text: One Proxmox host. VMs for the big things, one LXC per small job.
